# Getting help

For a reproducible bug, open an issue with the command, version, operating system, and the smallest
configuration that demonstrates it. Please redact local paths, proxy credentials, and tokens.

For usage questions, source availability, and ideas that are not yet scoped into a concrete change,
use GitHub Discussions when enabled. Feature requests should explain the downstream research problem
and the expected dataset or query contract; see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

Security issues must be reported privately through [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), never in a public
issue or discussion.
